column1: # THE CPI PERSISTENCE ROW (2026-10-12, item 60): the year-over-year inflation rate's correlation
# with itself twelve months on (`cpi_persistence` / `cpiPersistence`), read on CPI-U (FRED's
# CPIAUCSL, monthly log changes) over each set's rate window: the S&P set's 1954-2026, the
# Nasdaq set's 1999-2026. The windows disagree -- 0.73 against 0.26 -- and the breakeven rows
# (`tips-2026-10-11.tsv`) are the TIPS era's: a market whose inflation regimes last as 1954-2026's
# do moves its ten-year breakeven with the prints, where the 2003-2026 breakeven barely does. This
# row holds each set to its own window's persistence.
# Graded by where the record falls among the world's single histories of the window's length
# (the record's percentile, a miss outside 5-95), not by a record band: the statistic straddles a
# block join in every pair of a block resample, so the record sits at its own resamples' edge.
